A slip: a printed strip showing the whole card face except the art, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 March 2017 (the PDF was made on 31 May 2017).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-L-deathstardetentionblockcontrolroom-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Death Star: Detention Block Control Room (PC Errata 2016 disc card)]] (by 7 August 2016): Same game text. This is a slip: the whole card face except the art set again with this text, with a black strip below with a white italic “E” and no title.

The same area of the previous version (scaled to the slip's width) and the slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
